agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council Diana Giron, Acting City Clerk
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
JANUARY 22, 2008
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATION
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO STEPHEN LEE, CITY OF LA PUENTE EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH
Employee of the Month Certificate - Lee
Proclamation in honor of the City of Pico Rivera's 50th Anniversary.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE REVISED MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF DECEMBER 11, 2007 AND JANUARY 8, 2008
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meetings of December 11, 2007 and January 8, 2008.
December 11, 2007
January 8, 2008
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
ZONE CHANGE NO. 327 - PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER A REQUEST TO CHANGE THE ZONE DESIGNATION FROM R-1 TO C-2 FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 744 N. SIERRA VISTA COURT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony; (3) read the Ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce the Ordinance approving Zone Change 327 for subsequent adoption.
Zone Change NO. 327 Rpt.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AGREEMENT TO ASSUME LEASE OBLIGATIONS AND WAIVER OF RIGHT TO ABANDON EMINENT DOMAIN ACTION FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1313-1335 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agreement and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on its behalf.
Consideration of Agrt. Rpt.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1219 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
W/R #1219
D-2
TREASURER'S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THE MONTH ENDED OCTOBER 31, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council receives and files the Monthly Treasure's/Financial Report for the month ending October 31, 2007.
Month End October 2007 Rpt.
D-3
TREASURER'S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR THE MONTH ENDED NOVEMBER 30, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council receives and files the Monthly Treasurer's/Financial Report for the month ending November 30, 2007.
Month End November 2007 Rpt.
D-4
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM REUSE ACCOUNT AND ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CALHOME Monthly Rpt.
D-5
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2006-07 AND FY 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CDBG Monthly Rpt.
D-6
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING THE DESTRUCTION OF CITY RECORDS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution approving the destruction of City records.
Destruction Records Rpt.
Reso.
D-7
THE SUBMISSION OF THE CLICK IT OR TICKET MINI GRANT APPLICATION
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Click it or Ticket application submitted on January 7, 2008.
Click it or Ticket Rpt.
D-8
ACCEPTANCE OF COMPLETION FOR TEMPLE AVENUE STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT FROM GLENDORA AVENUE TO STIMSON AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) accept the Notice of Completion for the Temple Avenue Street Improvement Project; and (2) approve the resolution amending the adopted budget for fiscal year 2007-2008 to approve $9,059.33 in Proposition 42 Funds to pay the additional unforeseen construction work and advertisement for this project.
Temple Ave. Completion Rpt.
NOC - Attachment A
Reso. - Attachment B
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
It is recommended that the City Council vote for three candidates for the Planning Commission. Candidates must receive at least three votes to be appointed. The Council shall conduct two separate selection processes; a ballot for the two, two-year term seats, and separate ballot for the one, one-year term seat.
Consideration of Planning Comm. Rpt.
E-2
REQUEST THE CITY COUNCIL CONSIDER A POLICY FOR THE ROTATION OF MAYOR AND MAYOR PRO TEM (Requested by Council Member Solis)
None. AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Policy for Rotation Rpt.
AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this
___________________________________
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
